rules.detail: The feature (VALUES|table-valued functions|NATURAL JOIN|recursive CTEs|LATERAL subqueries|LATERAL joins|PIVOT and UNPIVOT|OFFSET|SELECT \* EXCEPT|qualified function names|named function arguments|LIKE ANY|FROM with several SELECT|QUALIFY|aggregate FILTER|DISTINCT aggregates over different|JOIN \.\.\. USING)

summary: query features the analyzer or planner lacks: inline VALUES, table-valued functions, NATURAL and USING joins, recursive CTEs, LATERAL, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, OFFSET, GROUP BY ALL, SELECT * EXCEPT, QUALIFY, named and qualified function names, LIKE ANY/ALL
